project.title: Effects of Enterococcus faecalis administration on the community structure of airborne bacteria in weanling piglet and layer hen houses
project.description: We investigated the effects of dietary Enterococcus faecalis on the bacterial community structure in the air of piglet and layer hen houses. Indoor air and feces from piglet and layer hen housing were sampled after supplementing E. faecalis in feed for 60 days, and bacterial community structures were analyzed using Illumina high-throughput sequencing technology.
project.center_name: Beijing Academy of Agriculture and Forestry Sciences
